state:
**Goal `html-later` — Stage 3 is closed. Stage 4 (the editor) and Stage 5 (the proofs gate) are open.** ADR 0266 decides the goal. `crates/nvs-runtime/src/later.rs` holds the slots and both deliveries. Its module doc § *A slotted response* says how the slotted one works and what it costs.

**On disk:** `rule:core-classes/html-later` is `shipped`. Its guards now include `crates/nvs-server/src/slotted/tests.rs` and `tools/nv/test/html-later-polyfill.test.ts`. That test streams a slotted page to Playwright's Chromium headless shell, launched once with `DocumentPatching` and once with both it and `HTMLProcessingInstruction` off. One extra page turns the markers into processing instructions, so both kinds of marker are covered. The test skips when no browser is downloaded, and fails instead under `NV_BROWSER`. CI's `browser` job sets that. `LANES.browser` in `tools/nv/cmd/ci-changes.ts` turns the job on. The polyfill now trims a marker's text (`<?end>` as a PI has empty data, so it read `"?end "` before) and removes both markers with the old content. `POLYFILL_HASH` matches the file.

**Known gaps, in `later.rs`'s module doc:** slots run when the frame returns, concurrently with each other but not with the main script. A `later` inside a `Core\Task::all` child is never assembled. A slot whose task is cancelled while it writes ends the stream, and the fills after it are not sent.

items.text: **Completion offers `later`'s options**: inside the `{…}` bag of a `Core\Html::later(…)` call, completion offers `placeholder`, `error` and `deadline`. Nothing in the LSP completes an options bag's keys yet. The nearest code is `route_keys` at `crates/nvs-lsp/src/completion.rs:1041` (keys for `Core\Router::url`'s params), and `core_parts` at `crates/nvs-lsp/src/completion.rs:2953` already spells the bag in a detail. The check wants the test `completion_offers_the_options_of_later`. `crates/nvs-lsp/tests/completion_edits.rs:234` is the nearest test to copy the shape of (`rule:core-classes/html-later`).

**Hover shows `later`'s card**: hover over `later` shows its `Core` card. `core` at `crates/nvs-lsp/src/hover.rs:589` builds a `Core` hover, and `core_member_hover` at `crates/nvs-lsp/src/card.rs:165` reads the card. Check that `later` has a card (`rule:core-api/reference-card`), then add the hover test the stage check names (`bun nv loop --list --stage 4`).

**Stage 5, the proofs gate**: `bun nv proofs --gate` must owe nothing with `later` and slotted routes in it. `bun nv proofs --id '<feature>'` lists what is still owed (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`), at `tools/nv/cmd/proofs.ts:1`.

Known gaps above stay in `crates/nvs-runtime/src/later.rs`'s module doc until a goal takes them.
